_about: Official Discord servers ProveIt can check. Only servers listed here can be verified, so a copycat server can never be used. Each role ID maps to one label: Admin or Mod. To copy IDs, turn on Discord Developer Mode (User Settings → Advanced), then right-click the server icon → Copy Server ID, and right-click a role on a member's profile → Copy Role ID. Changing guildId, name or roles changes the Discord action's CID and signer. officialSource (a page on the project's official website or X that links to the server) and listed are only used by the website. "listed": false keeps a private test server checkable but out of the public list (it appears only on /new?test); leave officialSource empty only for such test servers.
